messages:
jen (docs): Heads-up — PR #582 (migration guide) preview failing linkcheck + markdownlint after I renamed a couple headings. Need a tiny fix so it can merge in the morning window. CI output pasted below. CI Bot: docs-preview · ❌ checks failed - linkcheck: 3 broken internal anchors - markdownlint: MD033 (inline HTML), MD038 (no space after list marker), MD013 (line length) - vale: suggestions (avoid weasel words, passive voice) Full log: https://ci.internal.redwood/582/logs jen (docs): Failing anchors excerpt from migration.md: - [Auth changes](#old-auth) -> 404 in preview - [Session tokens](#session-token-migration) -> 404 - [Redirect flow](#redirects) -> 404 LinterBot: Quick analysis: those header slugs changed when you renamed headings (e.g., "Authentication changes" -> slug "authentication-changes"). Linkcheck expects exact slug. Also saw inline HTML
in the examples and a code fence without a language tag. Suggestions: ``` 1) update links to use `#authentication-changes` and `#session-token-migration` exact slugs 2) remove inline HTML, use blank lines for spacing 3) add language on fences: ```bash ``` ``` Alex K.: I can push a quick commit to fix anchors + add code fence language, but I'll be OOO 12:00-15:00 PT today. If someone can review and merge after CI passes, that helps. @docs-review can you pick this up? Maria S.: I can review now. Also Vale flagged "legacy auth flow" as vague — propose "deprecated auth flow" or be more specific (what is deprecated). Small wording nit. Kevin T.: Avoid adding HTML anchors. Our site generates slugs from headings. Best fix is to update the links to the new slug or revert the heading rename. If you want to keep the new heading, update links across the repo. Quick sed to find usage: `git grep -n "#old-auth" || true` Command to patch locally: `git checkout -b fix/docs/anchors && sed -i 's/#old-auth/#authentication-changes/g' docs/**/*.md` jen (docs): I'll add the follow-up commit with anchor updates + add `bash` to the code fences and remove the `
` instances. Assigning to @docs-review after commit and re-run CI. I opened a tracker ticket to sweep other refs: https://issues.internal/RED-934 CI Bot: Re-run started by jen (docs)... CI Bot: docs-preview · ❌ still failing - linkcheck: PASS - markdownlint: MD013 (line length) in docs/migration.md:234 — long example curl command not wrapped - vale: minor style suggestions remain Maria S.: I pushed a tiny wrap of the curl example (split over two lines with continuation) + changed "legacy" -> "deprecated auth flow". Taking a look now. Maria S.: :white_check_mark: looks good to me. Approving + leaving a quick comment about the phrasing in the changelog. jen (docs): Thanks — plan to merge in the morning merge window at 09:00 PT unless anyone objects. Note: this rename affected two other docs (SDK snippets). I created follow-up PRs to update those references (RED-935, RED-936) and added them to the docs sweep board. Alex K.: No objections. Thanks for the quick turn-around. :thumbsup: CI Bot: merge queue updated — #582 eligible for merge on next window (09:00 PT)
